name: Državni praznici i blagdani Republike Hrvatske (1992–2030)
title: Državni praznici i blagdani Republike Hrvatske (1992–2030)
description: Croatian state public holidays (državni praznici i blagdani) from 1992 (independence-era start) through 2030. Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/croatia.py, which encodes the current statute (Zakon o blagdanima, spomendanima i neradnim danima u Republici Hrvatskoj — Act 022-03/19-01/219 of 14 November 2019, Narodne novine 110/19) plus all historical variants since 1992: Easter Sunday was codified as a separate holiday only from 2009; Corpus Christi (Tijelovo) and Independence Day (Dan neovisnosti) ran 2002–2019; Statehood Day (Dan državnosti) shifted from 30 May (1996–2001 and 2020–present) to 25 June (2002–2019); Remembrance Day (Dan sjećanja na žrtvu Vukovara i Škabrnje) added in 2020. Each record carries the Gregorian date, Croatian + English + Ukrainian holiday names (vacanza supported_languages), Croatian + English weekday names, an is_weekend flag, and an is_estimated flag (TRUE for years 2026–2030 beyond vacanza's confirmed range).

meta.title: Državni praznici i blagdani Republike Hrvatske (1992–2030) - Besplatno preuzimanje
meta.description: Croatian state public holidays (državni praznici i blagdani) from 1992 (independence-era start) through 2030. Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/croatia.py, which encodes the current statute (Zakon o blagdanima, spomendanima i neradnim danima u Republici Hrvatskoj — Act 022-03/19-01/219 of 14 November 2019, Narodne novine 110/19) plus all historical variants since 1992: Easter Sunday was codified as a separate holiday only from 2009; Corpus Christi (Tijelovo) and Independence Day (Dan neovisnosti) ran 2002–2019; Statehood Day (Dan državnosti) shifted from 30 May (1996–2001 and 2020–present) to 25 June (2002–2019); Remembrance Day (Dan sjećanja na žrtvu Vukovara i Škabrnje) added in 2020. Each record carries the Gregorian date, Croatian + English + Ukrainian holiday names (vacanza supported_languages), Croatian + English weekday names, an is_weekend flag, and an is_estimated flag (TRUE for years 2026–2030 beyond vacanza's confirmed range). Sadrži 503 zapisa. Preuzmi u Excel, CSV, PDF formatima.
